howto.name: Upload an MP4 video
howto.text: Drop an MP4 file up to 200 MB — music videos, lecture recordings, podcasts, anything with audio.

howto.name: Extract audio and download
howto.text: Run the conversion. PrivaTools extracts the audio track and re-encodes it as MP3, perfect for offline listening on any device.

faq.q: Does this work for any MP4?
faq.a: Yes — as long as the MP4 has an audio track. Music videos, lecture recordings, podcasts, screen recordings with narration, all work.
The MP3's size depends on the length, not on the video: it is encoded at about 128 kbps, close to 1 MB per minute of stereo audio. This page takes MP4 files up to 200 MB.
No — only the audio track is extracted. If you also need the video, keep the original MP4.
